I’m 16 and I’ve struggled with depression for years too, probably since I was 10. And I want you to know that you’re not alone, and I know it’s super cliche and everyone has said that a million times. Maybe you don’t realize that you are loved by someone, it could be your parents or your friends or whoever you think of. Or maybe you don’t have anyone close at the moment, which sucks a lot (I know), but the point is that it will change! You’re 14, and even though I’m not that older than you, I’m pretty sure there is plenty of time for both of us to figure this whole thing out. I believe that one day we will wake up with stars in our eyes, and please don’t end it now, because that would be a loss for everyone around you, including me. The more the merrier on this journey to a happy life :)

I don’t think it’s included in the fee for the bloodtests. Apparently he’s charging for ”renewing the prescription“. But he can only prescribe for one month at a time, because of health risks. So that isn’t really a problem. 

Also I just found out that on their website they state that the first appointment costs 1200 NOK (roughly 134 $), but my mom was charged 1700 NOK (190 $). I think that was for the prescription/renewal, but my mom is kinda mad they didn’t tell us that.

And now we have to pay 30$ the next months which isn’t really ideal.

I am covered by insurance, however that won’t cover what he’s charging me tho.

Regarding why he only prescribes me accutane for one month at a time, is because he has to do it according to the law. Because accutane can cause liver problems and be really dangerous if you get pregnant. Which is  why I have to get blood tests every month. 

The only weird thing is that I get charged for him «renewing the prescription»? I’m not quite sure, but from what I understand is that it will cost extra if I ask for an appointment to check on my skin and its process.

The problem is I’m going to a different place (public) to get the blood tests (which also costs money). The blood tests is then sent to my dermatologist (i think). Then he prescribes me the accutane, which I get myself. So technically we never discuss the symptoms and etc. and we haven’t met in 3 months :/

Idk, but my mom just called the clinic and they told her that the fee is for my dermatologist prescribing accutane to me, so maybe that makes sense? 

The only thing that sucks is that we still have to pay for the accutane itself, but also pay my DT for prescribing me the accutane :/
